svg.title: Hosting Capacity Funnel, From Campus Load to Feeder Headroom
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-hosting-capacity-funnel; chapter number: 6; chart type: funnel; title: Hosting Capacity Funnel, From Campus Load to Feeder Headroom; subtitle: Published hosting values are screening ceilings, not connection rights; caption: A 60 MW facility load against a live distribution feeder demo shows how fast mapped headroom narrows; one month of delay on a 60 MW facility can cost up to $14 million (KorrAI).; assumptions note: Values are the cited MW figures at each screen. Stages 2, 3 and 5 come from Dan Rogers' Foxboro 2 feeder demo; stage 4 is a separate National Grid portal ceiling example. Conversion text describes the screen applied, not a computed rate.; note: Attributed to KorrAI (MvUw50RZNRQ) and National Grid Distributed Generation, Dan Rogers (KxAPuQUu_II).; stages: label: 60 MW data center target load; value: 60; display: 60 MW facility; conversion: Reference load KorrAI prices at up to $14M per month of delay; detail: Screen geology, karst, sinkholes and water tables before earthworks (KorrAI).; label: Foxboro 2 substation bank rating; value: 8; display: 8 MVA bank, 75% loaded; conversion: Distribution bank sits far below a campus-scale load; detail: Live Massachusetts portal demo (National Grid Distributed Generation).; label: Feeder available hosting capacity; value: 6.65; display: 6.65 MW available; conversion: Published value is a screening ceiling, not a connection right; detail: No ASO pending and high side protection already present, so 3V0 was not needed.; label: Mapped value treated as a ceiling; value: 5.2; display: 5.2 MW upper limit; conversion: A recloser without voltage supervisory control drags downstream values lower; detail: Separate National Grid portal example of a mapped upper limit.; label: DG already connected on the feeder; value: 0.35; display: 350 kW connected; conversion: Switch to connected plus pending to see the real queue; detail: Aggregate pending DG usually triggers an ASO study (National Grid Distributed Generation).
